description.value: Starbucks at 777 Royal Oak Drive is located in a retail plaza in the Royal Oak neighbourhood, one of the busier commercial corridors on the Saanich Peninsula north of Victoria's urban core. The store serves the full Starbucks menu of espresso drinks, cold beverages, and light food items with both dine-in and takeout available, including mobile and web ordering. It is a predictable, accessible stop for cyclists travelling through the Royal Oak area.
